translations.literal: He left his patent of appointment as pledge and came out in surrender together with several of their chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving his commission as surety, he emerged in surrender along with several bandit chiefs.

sentences.zh: 以賞遷吉州戶曹，改廣西經幹，復以弭盜賞，除四川制置司參議官。

translations.literal: For this reward he was transferred to Household Section clerk of Jizhou, changed to fiscal commissioner of Guangxi, again rewarded for quelling banditry, and appointed Planning Official of the Sichuan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Rewarded for this achievement he became Household Section clerk of Jizhou, then fiscal commissioner of Guangxi, and received further honors for suppressing banditry before appointment as Planning Official of the Sichuan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 北兵入成都，大異從制置使丁黼巷戰，兵敗，身被數創死，闔門皆遇難。

translations.literal: When northern troops entered Chengdu, Dayi followed Pacification Commissioner Ding Fu in street fighting; the army was defeated, he received several wounds and died, and the entire household met catastrophe.
translations.idiomatic: When northern troops entered Chengdu, Dayi fought beside Pacification Commissioner Ding Fu in the streets; the army was routed, he suffered multiple wounds and was left for dead, and his entire household perished.

sentences.zh: 詰旦，其部曲竊往瘞之，大異復蘇，負以逃，獲免。

translations.literal: At daybreak his retainers secretly went to bury him; Dayi revived, was carried away in flight, and escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn his retainers stole back to bury him; Dayi regained consciousness, was carried to safety, and survived.

sentences.zh: 進朝奉郎，宰石門縣，就除通判溧陽，攝州事，皆有惠政。

translations.literal: Promoted to Gentleman for Court Audience, he served as magistrate of Shimen County, then received concurrent appointment as Assistant Prefect of Liyang and acted in prefectural affairs—all with benevolent administration.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Gentleman for Court Audience, he governed Shimen County as magistrate, then served as Assistant Prefect of Liyang while acting prefect—all with notable benevolence.

sentences.zh: 去官之日，老弱攀號留之，大異易服潛去。

translations.literal: On the day he left office, old and young clung to him weeping and calling out to keep him; Dayi changed clothes and stole away secretly.
translations.idiomatic: On his last day in office the old and infirm wept and clung to him begging him to stay; Dayi changed clothes and slipped away unnoticed.

sentences.zh: 擢知登聞鼓院，遷大理寺丞，平反冤獄者七。

translations.literal: Promoted to administer the Court for Hearing Grievances, transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, he cleared seven wrongful cases.
translations.idiomatic: Elevated to administer the Court for Hearing Grievances and then appointed Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, he overturned seven wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 召對，極言時政得失，迕宰相意，出知澧州。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he spoke at length on the gains and losses of current policy, offended the chief councilor's intent, and was sent out as prefect of Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to audience he spoke bluntly on the faults of current policy, alienated the chief councilor, and was relegated to prefect of Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 理宗曰：“是四川死節更生者楊大異耶？

translations.literal: Emperor Lizong said: "Is this Yang Dayi of Sichuan, who died defending his post and came back to life?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Lizong asked: "Is this Yang Dayi—the man who died defending Sichuan and miraculously survived?

sentences.zh: 論事剴切，有用之材也。

translations.literal: In discussing affairs he is incisive and penetrating—a talent fit for employment.
translations.idiomatic: He speaks on state affairs with sharp insight—a man of real ability.

sentences.zh: 何遽出之？”

translations.literal: Why was he so hastily sent out?"
translations.idiomatic: Why was he dispatched so abruptly?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：“是人尤長於治民。”

translations.literal: The reply was: "This man is especially skilled at governing the people."
translations.idiomatic: The reply came: "This man is especially accomplished at governing the people."

sentences.zh: 命予節兼庾事，進直秘閣、提點廣東刑獄兼庾事。

translations.literal: He was ordered grants of seals with concurrent grain administration, promoted to Directly Attached to the Secret Archives and Judicial Commissioner of Guangdong with concurrent grain administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted seals of office with concurrent grain administration, promoted to Directly Attached to the Secret Archives and Judicial Commissioner of Guangdong with concurrent grain duties.

sentences.zh: 時常平司逋負山積，械系追索，奸蠹百出。

translations.literal: At that time the Ever-Normal Granaries' arrears piled like mountains; offenders were shackled and pursued for collection, and every sort of fraud flourished.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Ever-Normal Granary arrears had piled up like mountains; debtors were shackled and hounded for repayment, breeding every sort of official corruption.

sentences.zh: 大異與之約，悉縱遣之，負者如期畢輸，吏無所容其奸。

translations.literal: Dayi made an agreement with them, released all of them, and the debtors paid in full on schedule—the clerks had no room for their fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Dayi negotiated a settlement, released all the detainees, and debtors paid in full on schedule—leaving no opening for clerical fraud.

sentences.zh: 訪張九齡曲江故宅，建相江書院，以祀九齡。

translations.literal: He visited Zhang Jiuling's former residence at Qujiang, built the Xiangjiang Academy, and used it to sacrifice to Jiuling.
translations.idiomatic: He restored Zhang Jiuling's former residence at Qujiang, established the Xiangjiang Academy, and enshrined Jiuling there.

sentences.zh: 改提點廣西刑獄兼漕、庾二司，所至奸吏屏息，寇盜絕跡。

translations.literal: Changed to Judicial Commissioner of Guangxi with concurrent control of transport and grain commissions; wherever he went corrupt clerks held their breath and bandits vanished without trace.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned as Judicial Commissioner of Guangxi with concurrent authority over transport and grain commissions, he subdued corrupt officials and drove bandits from the region entirely.

sentences.zh: 凡可以為民興利除害者，必奏行之。

translations.literal: Whatever could benefit the people or remove harm, he necessarily memorialized and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Every measure that could benefit the people or eliminate harm he memorialized and implemented.

sentences.zh: 復建宣成書院祀張栻、呂祖謙。

translations.literal: He also rebuilt the Xuancheng Academy to sacrifice to Zhang Shi and Lü Zuqian.
translations.idiomatic: He also restored the Xuancheng Academy to honor Zhang Shi and Lü Zuqian.

sentences.zh: 廣海幅員數千里，道不拾遺，報政為最。

translations.literal: Across the broad sea of Guangdong and Guangxi spanning several thousand li, things lost on the road were not picked up, and his report of administration ranked foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout coastal Guangdong and Guangxi, a region thousands of li wide, lost goods went untouched on the road, and his record of governance ranked supreme.

sentences.zh: 未六十即丐致仕，不允，章四上，除秘閣修撰、太中大夫，提舉崇禧觀、醴陵縣開國男，食邑三百戶，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: Before reaching sixty he petitioned to retire; not permitted, he submitted four memorials, and was appointed Compiler of the Secret Archives, Grandee for Counselling the State, Administrator of the Chongxi Temple, Baron of the State of Liling County with a fief of three hundred households, and granted the purple-gold fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: Before turning sixty he petitioned to retire; refused at first, he submitted four memorials before receiving appointment as Compiler of the Secret Archives, Grandee for Counselling the State, Administrator of the Chongxi Temple, Baron of Liling with a fief of three hundred households, and the purple-gold fish pouch.

sentences.zh: 歸裏第，與居民無異，學者從之，講肄諄諄，相與發明經旨，條析理學。

translations.literal: Returning to his home estate, he was no different from ordinary residents; scholars followed him, and he lectured and instructed earnestly, jointly elucidating the meanings of the classics and systematically analyzing Neo-Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Back home he lived no differently from ordinary neighbors; scholars gathered to study with him as he lectured earnestly, jointly probing the classics and systematically explicating Neo-Confucian doctrine.

sentences.zh: 食祠祿者二十四年，卒，年八十二。

translations.literal: He received sacrificial stipends for twenty-four years, then died at age eighty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He drew temple stipends for twenty-four years before dying at eighty-two.

sentences.zh: 子霆、霖。

translations.literal: His sons were Ting and Lin.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Ting and Lin.

sentences.zh: 霆在《忠義傳》。

translations.literal: Ting is in the Biographies of Loyalty and Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Ting has a biography in the Loyalty and Righteousness section.

sentences.zh: 論曰：正論之在天下，未嘗亡也。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Right discourse in the realm has never perished.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator observes: principled criticism has never entirely vanished from the realm.

sentences.zh: 徐範之於韓侂胄，吳泳、李韶、王邁之於史氏，皆能無所回撓，正色直言。

translations.literal: Xu Fan toward Han Tuozhou, and Wu Yong, Li Shao, and Wang Mai toward the Shi clan, were all able without any bending or yielding to speak forthrightly with stern countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Fan in confronting Han Tuozhou, and Wu Yong, Li Shao, and Wang Mai in confronting the Shi faction, all stood firm without compromise, speaking with moral seriousness and direct candor.

sentences.zh: 至於史彌鞏則彌遠之弟，陳塤其甥也，不以私親而廢天下之公論。

translations.literal: As for Shi Migong, he was Mizong's younger brother, and Chen Xun was his nephew—yet they did not on account of private kinship abandon the realm's public discourse.
translations.idiomatic: Even Shi Migong, younger brother of Shi Miyuan, and Chen Xun, his nephew, refused to let family ties override public judgment.

sentences.zh: 抑孟子所謂“寡助之至”者歟？

translations.literal: Is this perhaps what Mencius called "the extreme of having few helpers"?
translations.idiomatic: Was this, perhaps, what Mencius meant by reaching the point of having scarcely any allies?

sentences.zh: 趙與芮揚歷最久，甘為聚斂之臣。

translations.literal: Zhao Yurui climbed longest in office, yet willingly became a minister who amasses revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yurui enjoyed the longest career among them, yet willingly served as a revenue-extraction official.

sentences.zh: 李大同以鄉人喬行簡為相，薦起之。

translations.literal: Li Datong, with his fellow townsman Qiao Xingjian as chief councilor, was recommended and raised up.
translations.idiomatic: Li Datong was brought back into office through the recommendation of his fellow townsman Qiao Xingjian, then chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 黃┿出仕，以恤民尊賢為急，可謂知本。

translations.literal: Huang Xun entered office with relief for the people and honoring the worthy as his urgency—he may be called one who knew the root.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Xun entered public service with urgent concern for the people's welfare and reverence for worthies—truly a man who understood what mattered most.

sentences.zh: 大異節義如此，宜其善政之著稱於世也。

translations.literal: Dayi's integrity and righteousness were thus; it is fitting that his good governance should be prominently praised in the world.
translations.idiomatic: With integrity and righteousness such as Yang Dayi's, it is no wonder his enlightened governance won lasting renown.
